purpose: Drug Interaction Checker - bundled dataset provenance
licensePolicy: commercial-clean only (public domain / CC0 / license-free); no NC sources

sources.name: VHA National Drug File - Reference Terminology
sources.provider: US Department of Veterans Affairs / NCI EVS
sources.notes: SEVERITY column is blank in all rows; pairs only. Public ontology uses role relations (CI_with/CI_ChemClass/CI_MoA/CI_PE and PK roles), no graded DDI table.

sources.name: Medication Reference Terminology
sources.verdict: No DDI pair table and no severity; accessory files are NDFRT<->MeSH and NDFRT<->RxNorm crosswalks only. Used for class normalization only.

sources.name: ONC high-priority DDI list (Phansalkar et al., JAMIA 2012; PMC3422823)
sources.notes: Class-expanded contraindicated pairs, '$'-delimited with DrugBank IDs (ignored). Used to force severity=contraindicated.

sources.name: NDFRT -> RxNorm name map
sources.notes: ';'-delimited rxcui;nui;drugname. Sufficient to name pairs; full RxNorm download not required.

sources.name: openFDA drug/label - static bulk export (DailyMed SPL)
sources.notes: Bulk export has NO openfda.rxcui; labels are matched to ingredients by normalized generic_name/substance_name. Full run scanned 262842 labels, kept 56494. Enrichment re-grades existing pairs from a +/-250-char context window (never overrides contraindicated). New-pair discovery is stricter: single-ingredient labels only, interaction/contraindication sections only, both drug names in the same sentence, explicit severity phrase.

openfdaNewPairs.discoveryRule: single-ingredient label; interaction/contraindication sections; both names in one sentence; explicit severity phrase
